messages:
laura: quick heads-up — fintech pilot asked for eval-triggered alerts that actually recommend batching/caching/quant profiles when quality or latency drifts. they want: per-prompt alerts, a suggested config, and an easy path to apply on Dedicated (one-click or at least 'copy config'). scope ask feels big, can we sketch an MVP?

sandeep: sounds valuable. MVP idea: 1) detection pipeline that flags regression on a prompt set, 2) deterministic rule-based recommendations (batch size, kv cache window, quant profile) + confidence score, 3) UI card with 'suggestion' and 'copy to config' button. postpone one-click apply with RBAC for next phase.

omar: technically feasible. eval-sentry already emits drift events; we can attach a small advisor that maps drift + latency/cost signals -> recs. start with heuristics: if median latency > target -> suggest smaller batch size or more perf quant, if token-cost spike -> suggest higher quantization / increase cache TTL.

maria: customer-facing note: must include expected tradeoffs (latency vs quality) and easy rollback. also need exportable audit log for compliance. pilot customers will reject anything that hurts accuracy even if cheaper.

laura: agreed. what are realistic acceptance criteria for a pilot? e.g., FP rate of alerts, measurable cost savings, and no customer-visible quality regressions?

sandeep: propose acceptance criteria: - false positive alert rate < 10% on historic replay sets - suggested config should show >=15% unit-cost reduction in 60% of flagged cases (simulated) - UI shows expected impact (latency/cost/quality) and has rollback path. pilot with 2 customers for 4 weeks.

omar: will prototype advisor as a lightweight rule engine. example rule snippet:```json
{
  "trigger": "latency_median > 300ms",
  "recommendation": {"batch_size": 1, "quant_profile": "int8_dynamic", "cache_ttl": 120},
  "rationale": "high latency due to large batch/kv misses"
}
``` That is a starting point; we can expand rules after initial feedback.

maria: also add gating: any recommendation that changes model variant (e.g., to a lower-precision-only variant) must include a guard: run 50 replay samples on the customer's golden set and show delta before applying.

deploybot: ticket created: DEV-4123 — advisor spike + UI card + audit log (assignee: omar) :robot_face:

laura: nice. next steps: @omar spike heuristics + short demo by next Wed; @maria draft pilot ops + rollback runbook; @sandeep will write a 1-pager with acceptance criteria and customer communication template. setting 30m sync for Friday to align.

sandeep: ok i'll drop calendar invite. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
note: thread is a short internal triage about customer-driven feature asks for optimize toolkit (batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts). contains a small config snippet and assigns an internal ticket.
